patch:
diff --git a/src/_pytest/one_based_source.py b/src/_pytest/one_based_source.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..e511794a3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/one_based_source.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest._code.code import getfslineno
+
+
+def one_based_source(obj: object) -> tuple[str | Path, int]:
+    """Return source location (path, lineno) for the given object.
+
+    Works exactly like :func:`_pytest._code.code.getfslineno`, except that
+    the line number is 1-based for consumers (such as source-link
+    generation) that expect one-based locations. The -1 sentinel for an
+    unknown line number is returned unchanged.
+
+    If the source cannot be determined return ("", -1).
+    """
+    fspath, lineno = getfslineno(obj)
+    if lineno >= 0:
+        lineno += 1
+    return fspath, lineno
notes:
Added src/_pytest/one_based_source.py which delegates to getfslineno and increments only nonnegative line numbers, preserving the -1 sentinel and all error paths; existing implementation untouched.
Agent-reported tests_run (not independently verified): "pip install -e . && python script asserting one_based_source(f) == getfslineno(f)+1 and one_based_source(obj) == ('', -1) for unresolvable objects \u2014 all assertions passed."
